user.title: Connect to TMDB
user.description: Enter your TMDB API Read Access Token. Create one under TMDB account Settings > API.

authorize.title: Authorize your TMDB account

error.invalid_auth: The TMDB access token is invalid.
error.not_authorized: The request has not been authorized on TMDB yet.

abort.already_configured: This TMDB account is already configured.
abort.missing_auth_data: Authentication data was lost. Start setup again.

general.title: General settings

data.use_profile_language: Use TMDB profile language and region

general.description: Account-wide settings. Discovery filtering is configured separately for each Discovery profile.

profile.title: Discovery profile
profile.description: Step 1 of 3: choose the profile name, media type and recommendation source.

profile_person.title: Find a person
profile_person.description: Search TMDB for an actor, director, writer or other filmmaker.

profile_person_select.title: Select person
profile_person_select.description: Choose the intended person. Known works are shown to disambiguate identical names.

profile_awards.title: Awards
profile_awards.description: Step 2 of 3: optionally constrain this profile by an award source.

profile_award_details.title: Award filters
profile_award_details.description: Step 2 of 3: choose award category, status and year range. The next screen contains the profile's ordinary discovery filters.

profile_filters.title: Discovery filters
profile_filters.description: Set rating, votes, genres, providers and release-year filters. Use 'Maximum age in years' for a rolling window, e.g. 3 means titles from the current year and previous three years.

error.cannot_connect: Could not load data from TMDB.
error.person_not_found: No matching people were found on TMDB.
